issue_description: Customer reports payment deducted but order not confirmed
resolution_steps: 1. Check transaction status in payment gateway logs. 2. If deducted, initiate refund within 3-5 business days. 3. Ask customer to retry with a different payment method. 4. Share transaction reference number for tracking.

issue_description: UPI payment failed but amount debited from bank account
resolution_steps: 1. Verify UPI transaction ID with the bank. 2. If amount is debited, it will auto-reverse within 24-48 hours. 3. If not reversed, raise dispute with the bank using UPI transaction ID. 4. Offer alternative payment method.

issue_description: Customer hasn't received refund after 7 days
resolution_steps: 1. Check refund status in the payment dashboard. 2. Confirm the refund was initiated and note the reference ID. 3. Contact payment gateway if refund is stuck. 4. Inform customer of expected timeline (5-7 business days).

issue_description: Customer not receiving OTP for payment verification
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to check spam/blocked messages folder. 2. Verify the registered mobile number is correct. 3. Suggest retrying after 2 minutes. 4. Offer alternative verification methods like email OTP.

issue_description: Customer charged twice for the same order
resolution_steps: 1. Verify transaction logs for duplicate entries. 2. Confirm order was placed once. 3. Initiate immediate refund for the duplicate charge. 4. Send confirmation email with refund reference ID.

issue_description: Payment page showing gateway error or timing out
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to clear browser cache and retry. 2. Suggest using a different browser or device. 3. Check if gateway is experiencing downtime. 4. Offer COD or alternative payment method.

issue_description: Customer unable to log in to their account
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to try password reset via registered email. 2. Verify account exists with the email/phone provided. 3. Check for account suspension or ban. 4. Escalate to tech team if issue persists after reset.

issue_description: Account locked after multiple failed login attempts
resolution_steps: 1. Verify customer identity via OTP on registered mobile. 2. Unlock account from admin panel. 3. Reset password and send temporary credentials. 4. Advise customer on account security best practices.

issue_description: Customer's KYC verification is pending or rejected
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to re-upload clear, valid documents. 2. Ensure documents match the name on the account. 3. Manually review uploaded documents within 24 hours. 4. Notify customer via email once KYC is approved or rejected with reasons.

issue_description: Customer unable to update mobile number or email
resolution_steps: 1. Verify customer identity with OTP on current registered contact. 2. Guide customer through profile update steps. 3. If OTP not received, check if number is blocked. 4. Update details manually from admin panel if needed.

issue_description: Order confirmation not received after payment
resolution_steps: 1. Check order database for the transaction. 2. If payment is captured but order not created, manually create the order. 3. Send confirmation email immediately. 4. Offer compensation if significant delay caused.

issue_description: Customer received a different item than ordered
resolution_steps: 1. Apologize and confirm the error. 2. Arrange immediate return pickup. 3. Dispatch the correct item with priority shipping. 4. Offer discount on next purchase as compensation.

issue_description: Order not delivered within the promised timeframe
resolution_steps: 1. Check shipping partner tracking status. 2. Contact logistics partner for delay reason. 3. Provide updated estimated delivery date. 4. Offer partial refund or store credit if delay exceeds 48 hours.

issue_description: Customer wants to cancel the order
resolution_steps: 1. Check if the order is still in pre-dispatch stage. 2. Cancel the order and initiate refund within 24 hours. 3. Send cancellation confirmation email. 4. If already shipped, initiate return process.

issue_description: Customer wants to return a product
resolution_steps: 1. Verify if the item is within the return window (typically 7-30 days). 2. Check product condition eligibility for return. 3. Schedule return pickup. 4. Process refund once returned item is received and inspected.

issue_description: Customer received a damaged or broken product
resolution_steps: 1. Apologize for the inconvenience. 2. Ask customer to share photos of damage. 3. Verify authenticity of damage claim. 4. Send replacement immediately or process full refund based on customer preference.

issue_description: Order dispatched to wrong address
resolution_steps: 1. Contact logistics partner immediately to intercept. 2. Update delivery address in the system. 3. If not interceptable, initiate re-dispatch to correct address. 4. Offer priority shipping and keep customer informed.

issue_description: Delivery agent misbehaved or didn't attempt delivery
resolution_steps: 1. Apologize on behalf of the delivery partner. 2. Verify non-delivery from logistics tracking. 3. Re-schedule delivery for the earliest slot. 4. Report the agent's behavior to the logistics partner and follow up.

issue_description: App crashes on opening or during checkout
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to update to the latest app version. 2. Suggest clearing app cache and data. 3. If issue persists, ask for device model and OS version. 4. Escalate to tech team with logs if needed.

issue_description: App pages loading very slowly
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to check internet connection speed. 2. Suggest closing background apps and retrying. 3. Clear app cache. 4. If server-side issue, acknowledge and provide ETA for resolution.

issue_description: Search results not showing relevant products
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to use different search keywords. 2. Check if search index is up to date. 3. Provide direct link to the product if customer knows what they want. 4. Escalate search relevance issue to product team.

issue_description: Technical error during payment processing
resolution_steps: 1. Ask customer to retry after 5 minutes. 2. Suggest using a different payment method. 3. Check gateway status page for incidents. 4. Manually process payment if issue persists and customer is urgent.

issue_description: Discount coupon not applying at checkout
resolution_steps: 1. Verify the coupon code is valid and not expired. 2. Check if the coupon applies to the items in cart. 3. Confirm minimum cart value is met. 4. Apply discount manually or provide a new valid coupon.

issue_description: Promised cashback not credited to wallet
resolution_steps: 1. Verify the transaction qualifies for cashback. 2. Check cashback processing timeline (usually 3-7 days). 3. Manually credit cashback if timeline has passed. 4. Send confirmation of cashback credit.

issue_description: Subscription plan not activated after payment
resolution_steps: 1. Verify payment receipt in system. 2. Manually activate the subscription plan. 3. Extend subscription period to compensate for delay. 4. Send confirmation with new subscription end date.

issue_description: Customer disputes unexpected auto-renewal charge
resolution_steps: 1. Verify if auto-renewal was enabled. 2. Check if reminder email was sent before renewal. 3. If no reminder was sent, process full refund. 4. Disable auto-renewal as per customer request.

issue_description: Wallet balance not reflecting after recharge
resolution_steps: 1. Verify recharge transaction in payment logs. 2. Check wallet service for processing delays. 3. Manually credit the wallet balance if confirmed. 4. Send updated balance confirmation.

issue_description: Wallet payment failing at checkout
resolution_steps: 1. Check wallet balance is sufficient. 2. Verify wallet service is operational. 3. Ask customer to link a different payment method. 4. Escalate to wallet service team if balance exists but payment fails.

issue_description: Customer reports a transaction they didn't authorize
resolution_steps: 1. Immediately freeze the customer account. 2. Initiate fraud investigation with the payment team. 3. Reverse the unauthorized transaction. 4. Guide customer to change password and enable 2FA.

issue_description: Customer believes their account has been compromised
resolution_steps: 1. Immediately reset account password. 2. Log out all active sessions. 3. Verify recent account activity with customer. 4. Enable 2FA and notify via email. 5. Escalate to security team for full audit.
